extDescription.message: Blur or hide noisy X replies with local, reversible keyword rules - no APIs, cookies, or account changes.

filter_effect_hint.message: Choose whether matched replies are blurred or hidden.

account_lists_enabled_hint.message: Apply both local account rules and enabled external account sources.

account_source_link.message: View public data and audit history

account_blacklist_hint.message: Local account blacklist. Enter one numeric X ID or @handle per line.

account_whitelist_hint.message: Local account whitelist. It always overrides every blacklist.

my_keywords_hint.message: Add words or regular expressions that should trigger filtering. Use one rule per line.

whitelist_hint.message: Replies matching these rules are never filtered. Use one rule per line.

theme_hint.message: Choose how the extension looks in light and dark environments.

language_hint.message: Choose the language used by BlueNoise.

show_badge_count_hint.message: Show the number of filtered replies on the BlueNoise toolbar icon.

reveal_on_hover_hint.message: In Blur mode, show a clear area around the cursor.

match_names_hint.message: Include the author's display name and @handle when matching keywords.

ignore_spaces_hint.message: Match keywords even when spaces or hidden characters are inserted between letters.

case_sensitive_hint.message: Match uppercase and lowercase letters exactly; custom regex rules use their own flags.

debug_logging_hint.message: Write filtering diagnostics to the DevTools console of the page being filtered.
